interest: Tracks a 1932 inquiry on an incompetent ward's bank deposits.
overview: Docket indexes 1932 correspondence: Rothermel asks State how to retrieve deposits for incompetent ward Samuel Mack at Yokohama's bank branch.

people.name: Samuel Mack
people.role: Japanese subject and depositor declared of incompetent mind

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers docket sheet recording correspondence regarding bank deposits of an incompetent Japanese subject held in the Yokohama Specie Bank in New York City.
subfiles.summary: Indexes 1932 letters: attorney Rothermel, for guardian Murtaugh, asks Far Eastern Affairs how incompetent ward Samuel Mack can retrieve deposits at Yokohama Specie Bank's New York branch, with a reply sent December 5.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Japanese Branch Banks in the United States
